mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_no, c.comment_content, c.created_at, c.user_id, u.user_nick FROM comment c JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.comment_no = #{commentNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board.comment (comment_content, comment_plus_no, user_id) VALUES (#{commentContent}, #{commentPlusNo}, #{userId})
